newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Sonae to expand in Brazil - paper.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Sonae to expand in Brazil - paper.

text.p: Portugal's biggest retailer Sonae Investimentos is negotiating the purchase of a large retail chain in northern Brazil with a view to becoming a national player in the Brazilian market, a Lisbon newspaper reported on Thursday.
"Talks are going on with existing chains with a view to their total or partial acquisition or the attainment of cooperation agreements," a company source told Diario Economico newspaper.
Sonae's expansion strategy should double the group's sales by the end of 1998 and ensure it "changes from a regional operator to a company that operates on a national level," the source said.
Sonae officials were not immediately available.
Sonae's Brazilian retail unit is Companhia Real Distribuicao.
